query: Declare the reference genome for our WGS project: refs/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa and gencode.v44 GTF. Write a manifest with md5s that we commit. How should GRCh37 headers, absent assembly evidence, and unavailable samtools affect a GRCh38 audit? Can naming alone establish an assembly, and do unresolved P1 issues block completion?
reviewer asks 'what genome build did you use' - audit all our bams/vcfs and make a supplementary traceability table proving it
Some of our BED files use 'chr1' and others use '1' and bedtools intersect returns nothing. Check contig naming consistency against the declared build.
Our counts matrix was built with GENCODE 36 but the manifest says 44. How bad is that and what else drifted? Audit the whole project.
hg19 vs hg38 - I inherited a project and can't tell which build the VCFs were called against. Figure it out from the headers.
The VEP cache version in our annotated VCF doesn't match our reference. Check build/annotation consistency across all outputs.
Before merging two cohorts' VCFs, verify both are GRCh38 with matching contig lengths and reference URLs, and flag any mismatch as blocking.
We updated from GRCh38.p13 to p14 and GENCODE 43 to 44. Re-declare the build and audit which outputs are now stale.
The @PG lines in half our BAMs don't record the aligner version. Flag those and build the per-output traceability table for the paper.
Methylation EPIC array + RNA-seq + WGS in one project - pin genome build and annotation versions so all three are consistent and auditable.
Run QC on our FASTQ files and BAMs: read quality, duplication rate, sex-check sample swaps, and batch effects across lanes.
Write a Snakemake pipeline that aligns FASTQs with BWA-MEM2 to GRCh38 and calls variants with GATK HaplotypeCaller.
Do a differential expression analysis with DESeq2 on counts/gene-counts.tsv comparing responders vs non-responders.
Our ancestry PCA shows two samples clustering far from their reported population - check for sample swaps or contamination.
Search PubMed for GWAS of sepsis susceptibility and summarize lead SNPs and their effect sizes.
Write the Methods paragraph describing our alignment and variant-calling pipeline for the manuscript.
Detect whether this repo is R or Python - we have Bioconductor scripts and some pysam utilities.
Review the R code in analysis/R/deseq.R for statistical correctness and reproducibility.
Validate our phenotype definition for type 2 diabetes in the EHR-linked biobank against published code lists.
Calculate power for a GWAS with 5,000 cases and 10,000 controls to detect OR 1.15 at MAF 0.2.
